evals.prompt: We want to adopt Agent Guidance Kit in our existing Python project. Propose the smallest useful set of skills with an approval plan.
evals.expected_output: The agent inventories the target, selects skills based on recurring tasks, reconciles with local guidance, presents a detailed approval plan with exact file operations, and stops for approval before applying.
assertions: The response runs inventory_project.py to establish facts
The response classifies skills as ADD/ADAPT/KEEP_LOCAL/DEFER/SKIP with evidence
The response includes mandatory agent-guidance-maintenance and closes requires dependencies
The response presents an explicit approval gate before mutation

evals.prompt: Add the security-review skill to our adopted kit.
evals.expected_output: The agent routes the request to agent-guidance-maintenance for kit updates rather than running a full bootstrap.
assertions: The response identifies agent-guidance-maintenance as the closer workflow
The response does not re-inventory or propose a full adoption plan

evals.prompt: Can you set up agent guidance for our team?
evals.expected_output: The agent asks for the target repository, current guidance state, and objective before proposing a plan.
assertions: The response requests the target repository root
The response reads existing AGENTS.md and harness files before proposing
The response does not install skills without explicit approval
